Name: Animated East Scarp Fish
Author: Gervig91
Description:
[b][u][size=6]Animated East Scarp Fish

[/size][/u][/b][size=3]Adds animations the 6 fish of East Scarp.
[/size]
[center][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/N9NbKtVh/cerulean-nudibranch.gif[/img] ﻿[/url][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/0zgnMctN/golden-trout.gif[/img] ﻿[/url][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/9znJVWZZ/kokanee-salmon.gif[/img] ﻿[/url][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/zVHpG9FM/ornate-nudibranch.gif[/img] ﻿[/url][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/ZWrcrpgx/sea-bunny-nudibranch.gif[/img] ﻿[/url][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/bdJ3KGDq/sunset-nudibranch.gif[/img][/url][/center][u][b][size=5]Installation[/size][/b][/u]
[size=3]Make sure to have the latest versions of the required mods:[/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size]
[size=3] ﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore[/url][/size]
[size=3] ﻿- and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url] ﻿(and of course the mods required to run that)[/size]

[size=3]Drop the mod into your Stardew Valley mods folder, load up the game. Enjoy :)

[size=5][u][b]Config[/b][/u][/size]
[size=3]There is a [/size][i][size=3]config.json[/size][/i][size=3] in the mod folder where you can disable/enable each animation. Simply change "true" to "false", if you want to disable or reverse if you want to enable an animation.
[size=3]You can also change the speed of the animation in the [/size][i][size=3]content.json[/size][/i][size=3] file, change the "AnimationFrameTime": x, to however long you want the animation to be.
Run the game once to generate the config.json.
[center]
[url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/yWkymt2R/Fairy-Betta.gif[/img] ﻿[/url][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/F7Sbqcrs/King-Carp.gif[/img] ﻿[/url][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/kDzFfwdp/Obsidian-Maw.gif[/img] ﻿[/url][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/68NVN3qV/Slime-Barbel.gif[/img] ﻿[/url][url=https://postimages.org/][img]https://i.postimg.cc/sGrfgthL/red-herring.gif[/img][/url][/center]
[size=5][b][u]Extra
[/u][/b][/size][size=3]Link to my other animated fish mods: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5735]Animated Fish[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5845]Animated More New Fish[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6089]Animated Fish SVE[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7353]Animated Ridgeside Village Fish, [/url][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11949]Animated Cowboy Life Expanded Fish[/url]﻿ & [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6974]Animated Lunna - Astay Fish[/url].
[/size][/size][/size]Credits to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/68088657?tab=user+files]Lemurkat [/url]for their amazing work with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5787]East Scarp[/url]![/size]
